memo: Incumbent is now 1.0964 (slot 17, one run). Halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2^18 gave the only accepted gain (-0.0181 vs the old incumbent). It is the biggest effect so far, and more optimizer steps in the fixed 300s seem to matter most. Smaller gains were all rejected as single runs: SwiGLU 2048 (-0.0033), gradient clipping (-0.0015), WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.3 (-0.0010). These may be noise. Hurt: larger or deeper models (DEPTH 10 +0.0496, DEPTH 6/AR 96 +0.0109), HEAD_DIM 64 (+0.0119), zero-init lm_head with higher unembedding LR (+0.0114), WARMUP_RATIO 0.03 (+0.0106), and weight decay 0.1 (+0.0018). Next: replicate 2^18 to confirm it is real. Then try 2^17 (slot 11 failed to patch, so rewrite it carefully). Then stack SwiGLU, clipping and WARMDOWN 0.3 on the new base. Avoid larger models and warmup. Keep the code simple.
